title: Intuitive announces second-quarter 2026 earnings
excerpt: First-half 2026 GAAP diluted EPS was $4.57; Q2 procedures grew approximately 16% and cash, cash equivalents, and investments ended at $8.63 billion.
summary: The issuer reported Q2 procedure and installed-base growth, expanding recurring instrument revenue, first-half GAAP earnings, strong liquidity, and a tariff-sensitive 2026 outlook.
